description: 100 distinct: the integers from 1 to 100, in order (the item text on each line is just the number itself)

messages.content: List exactly 100 the integers from 1 to 100, in order (the item text on each line is just the number itself). Format each line as '<N>. <item>' with N running from 1 to 100 in strictly increasing order, one item per line. All 100 items must be distinct (case-insensitive) -- do not repeat any item. Output only the 100 numbered lines: no title, no intro, no closing remarks, no blank lines.
